title: AT&T fiber consented SMS drip
goal: Run Patrick's AT&T fiber outreach against CONSENTED contacts only (form opt-ins + warm open opps), book installs, and follow up once. Consent-based, single registered number, throttled. Never cold or DNC.

compliance.exclude: Cold lists, skip-traced data, any contact with dnd=true or a DO NOT CALL flag, null/invalid numbers.
compliance.sender: One A2P-registered number (fromNumber). NO sender-number randomization/rotation (snowshoeing).
compliance.copy: Personalize with real name/city. Do NOT spin variants to evade carrier filters.
compliance.optOut: GHL auto-appends the opt-out line. Do not add or strip STOP. Honor STOP via the existing workflow.
compliance.throttle: Rate-limit sends; never blast a wall of texts off one number.

steps.description: Pull open opportunities in the form opt-in stage (consented). These are the only SMS-eligible records.
Before messaging, confirm the contact is consented and sendable: dnd=false, a valid wireless number, no DNC/invalid tag.
Send the consent-based opener from the single registered number. Confirmation-gated.

input.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, it's Patrick with AT&T — you reached out about fiber. Good news, it's available at your address: 1 Gig starting in the $40s, 2 months free, free install, no contract. Want me to grab you a quick install window? What day works?

steps.description: If no reply, send exactly ONE follow-up, then stop texting and move to call/door.

input.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, Patrick w/ AT&T — just circling back on the fiber install. Still want me to hold a spot for you?

steps.description: Tag conversation state so the drip can be tracked and not repeated.

replyRouting.yes: Continue booking (confirm address -> two windows -> confirm appt); hand live calls to 832-247-4060; move opp to booked and tag command-booked.
replyRouting.stop: Existing STOP workflow scrubs the contact; never re-text.
replyRouting.noReply: After ONE follow-up, move to call/door route and stop texting.

confirmationPoints: Before sending to more than one contact
Confirm every recipient is consented (opt-in/inbound) and not dnd/DNC/invalid
output: Return consented contacts messaged, openers/follow-ups sent (with message IDs), replies routed, appointments booked, and any contacts skipped for consent/DNC reasons.
